clubs.tacticsWhy: Bundesliga.com 2026/27: possession 55% (2nd), open-play pass accuracy 87.8% (3rd), open-play crosses 74 (1st), shots 101 (2nd), but intensive runs 3179 (15th) and sprints 814 (9th). At Mainz: 53% possession (FotMob; ZDF gives 52.21%), and ZDF notes the team slowing the game by circulating the ball after taking the lead. Pre-season analyses (Roundtable Jul 2026, TacticalFootballAnalysis Aug 2026) describe positional possession, a 3-2 build-up and counter-pressing. Short, controlled passing gives passing 2 and tempo 3; the league's most crosses give width 4. Low running numbers temper the counter-press claims, so press is 3. Line 3 because no line data was found. García took several free-kick crosses at Mainz, which is not enough for a set-piece label, so set pieces are placeholders.
